title: School Intervention With Daily Physical Activity and Healthy Food for Students With an Intellectual Disability.
brief_summary: A whole of school intervention with daily physical activity and healthy food for students with intellectual disabilities. The aim is to provide plenty of concrete examples of healthy life style choices and using school personnel and peers as role models. This will presumably result in healthier weight, better fitness and not least in new familiar healthy habits.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mild/moderate intellectual disability
* students at the upper secondary schools for intellectual disability students

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe intellectual disability
* obesity related syndromes
* major physical disabilities
